MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "A Pentatonix Christmas felt like a natural next choice because it connects directly to the Christmas albums I repeatedly listened to.",
    "Its vocal harmonies also fit my interest in The New Old Fashioned, giving me a reason to try it beyond the holiday theme alone."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Ritchie Valens and Jay & The Americans collections point toward oldies listening, which is not what drew me to my recent albums.",
    "Live musical-theater recordings and stage songs do not satisfy the same interest as Christmas music and vocal harmonies.",
    "Titles such as Anthology, Partners, and Lead With Your Heart leave their connection to my listening uncertain; with my limited activity, that uncertainty is enough for me to pass."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The choices seem to stretch my interest in vocal music into an interest in a broad range of singers and vocal collections.",
    "Some recommendations seem to assume that familiar songs or retrospective collections would appeal to me simply because I listened to classic Christmas albums."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Christmas listening, including returning to The Classic Christmas Album, is a stronger clue than a general interest in albums featuring singers.",
    "My latest interaction with The New Old Fashioned matters alongside that holiday history; a choice connecting both interests gives me a clearer reason to engage."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "One recommendation connected my holiday listening with vocal harmonies, while most stretched those interests into music I have little reason to choose now."
}
